name: Ascension
audio: deep ice groaning, a cold crystalline choir and a low dragon breath; no speech
world: The hall is alive: frost creeps over the stone, snow and diamond dust drift, ice shards turn in slow orbit, the windows glitter and cold light shifts across the pillars.

actions.beat: Frost spreads across the hall floor and up the pillars, the windows frosting over as the great shadow of Glaciora fills them.
{{She}} raises the staff and the great crystal ignites, ice shards lifting to orbit it in a slowly turning ring as {{her}} mantle crystallises at the hem.
A storm of snow and diamond dust spirals around {{her}} while Glaciora lowers its head to the window, and {{she}} turns a calm, absolute look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
